skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 100% ATK(+10) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK(+10) DMG to enemies in a cross-shaped area, with a 100% chance to grant himself [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 20% of own HP).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK(+10) DMG to enemies in a cross-shaped area, with a 100% chance to grant himself [Tenacity] (absorbs DMG equal to 20% of own HP). After acting, [Dispels] his own debuffs.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). For each Grappler ally in the team, Armored Gorilla's DMG Reduction Rate increases by 15%, up to 3 stacks.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). For each Grappler ally in the team, Armored Gorilla's DMG Reduction Rate increases by 15%, up to 4 stacks.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). For each Grappler ally in the team, Armored Gorilla's DMG Reduction Rate increases by 18%, up to 4 stacks.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage over time and damage types (Damage, Internal Damage, Charge).
